title: Rava son of Rav Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.62b.19); Hyman reports Rav Ulla as the reading in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Rava son of Rav Ilai interprets Isaiah’s description of the daughters of Zion. Rav Ulla is Hyman’s report from Dikdukei Soferim.
